_doc: Hand-written map from each KB slot (rulebook/kb/routing_knowledge_base.json) to the facts in data/build/facts.json. Holds no patient facts: only fact categories, IPS sections, ICD-10/ATC prefixes, KB drug classes and generic English/German search words. Loaded and validated with the KB at start-up (engine/kb.py): every KB slot must have an entry here and every entry must be a KB slot. Review together with the KB.
_notes: select = list of selectors; a fact is in the slot if ANY selector takes it. Inside one selector: categories / ips_sections give the base set (all facts if neither is given); icd10 / atc / drug_classes are code filters (the fact must match at least one of those given); match / match_all / exclude are case-insensitive regexes over the fact's English label + attribute values; status_in filters the fact status (current / historical / planned / recommended); assertion_in / assertion_not_in filter IBM's status (positive / negative / suspected / statuspost / recommended).
role 'context' = shown beside the slot's own value (e.g. echo findings beside LVEF) but never counted as the value itself.

drug_classes ['*'] = every KB drug class whose feeds_slots lists this slot (KB note on B07: class slots are filtered views of current medication). A medication matches a class through its generic name, brand or label (KB drug_classes generics/brands_examples), never through the free text of a letter.

always_not_documented: the build has no extracted fact of this kind (no lab values except HbA1c are documented; no airway, code status, smoking or diet facts). The card says 'not documented', names what was searched (the slot's hints_de over all passages) and, for lab slots (lab_table: true), links the lab-result table rows as the searched passage (KB slot_notes).
Codes are copied from the KB slot_codes (marked 'from memory; verify') plus D48.6 for breast lesions of uncertain behaviour; they need the same verification.
compute names the engine/fill.py function for the KB shape; it defaults to the slot's shape. age_sex and med_changes are special computes for latest_value / event_history slots.

age_sex._notes: Age is calculated from the date of birth at the anchor date (latest document); a stated age in a letter is only used for the X02 check, the patient header age is never used. Sex from document wording (Patientin/Frau vs Patient/Herr).

weight._notes: Trend of every dated weight; change = last minus first, inputs linked.

height_bmi._notes: Newest height and newest stated BMI, one each. BMI recomputation is check X01 (compare/).

vitals_bp_hr._notes: Dated list; no change is calculated (BP is a pair, heart rate mixes resting and Holter values).

spo2_resp._notes: Only temperature is extracted by the pipeline.

allergies._notes: Checklist per KB B01 why_override (drug, latex, contrast). cave.json's vague entry has no document link and is not a fact (KB slot_notes).

code_status._notes: No advance-directive or resuscitation fact is extracted.

mobility_function._notes: General condition (AZ) is the nearest documented functional statement; MMSE (cognition) is not mapped here.

smoking_alcohol._notes: Pipeline extracts no smoking or alcohol fact.

diagnoses_all._notes: IBM status shown with the KB status vocabulary: negative = ruled out, suspected = suspected, statuspost = past.

procedures_all._notes: Recommended or planned procedures are excluded (they feed board/follow-up/plan slots and are never shown as done).

prior_similar_episode._notes: Presenting events and documented causes always; plus earlier diagnoses whose wording matches the symptom family named in the situation text (generic symptom words only). Hypertensive crisis is checked for dizziness and visual symptoms as a known mimic.

discharge_followups._notes: Follow-up recommendations only; the tumour-board recommendation is its own slot.

followup_done._notes: For each recommended follow-up, look for a fact of the matching kind dated after the recommendation (at the fact's date precision). None found = 'not documented', never 'no'. A recommendation of a kind not listed here is shown as 'no evidence search defined'.

med_stopped_changed._notes: Drugs on an earlier list but not on the latest list, and same drug with a different dose or schedule.

carotid_stenosis._notes: Side from the fact (text); side conflicts come from compare/ (check X03).

vascular_imaging._notes: Also any imaging fact that states contrast use or a non-contrast ('native') series (KB B05: earlier contrast studies and whether contrast was avoided).

diabetes_dx._notes: Newest wording; the first documented date is shown for duration (no onset date is extracted).

diabetic_complications._notes: Hypertensive retinopathy is not a diabetic complication and stays in eye_history.

lipids._notes: No lipid values; hyperlipidaemia diagnoses are in diagnoses_all.

kidney_function._notes: No creatinine/eGFR anywhere (KB slot_notes); a coded renal diagnosis would appear in diagnoses_all.

receptors_ki67._notes: Newest value per receptor (ER, PR, HER2, hormone receptor) and for Ki-67.

prior_anaesthesia._notes: An earlier operation is not evidence of an anaesthesia record; only explicit anaesthesia wording counts.
